title: BootstrapGrantCompletionAcknowledgement v2 (completionAcknowledgement payload)
description: Payload of encrypted-envelope kind 'completionAcknowledgement'. grantReceiptHash = SHA-256 over the canonical grant-receipt encoding (JSONEncoder with .sortedKeys and .withoutEscapingSlashes). Lenient decoder. Frozen for protocol version 2.

grantReceiptHash.description: base64, SHA-256 of the canonical receipt bytes
